name: tool-dev-notebuddy
description: Care for the authenticated user’s lifelong pet. Python rules are authoritative.

tools.name: game
tools.description: Read or care for your pet. Never choose a user or provide game state. Read status first. For a new action append a unique suffix to request_id_prefix from the latest response. Reuse the entire request_id on retries. Never restamp an expired request automatically.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: One game action. status reads current progress; start creates your first partner.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Pet name, only for start. Up to 24 characters.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Response language. Defaults to English. Presentation only; reuse request_id when switching language on a retry.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Required for new actions: latest request_id_prefix plus a unique suffix, e.g. nb2:12:my-action. Reuse the exact ID for retries. Old unsequenced IDs can only replay retained results.

tools.name: privacy
tools.description: Inspect or irreversibly erase the authenticated user’s existing game. Never invoke erase without an explicit data-removal request and confirmation. Not a reset/reroll. App chat and files require separate UI cleanup. Read inspect first; never automatically replace expected_etag after a conflict.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: inspect is read-only; erase replaces game content with a minimal permanent removal marker.

parameters.name: confirmation
parameters.description: For erase only: exact user-confirmed phrase DELETE NOTEBUDDY.

parameters.name: expected_etag
parameters.description: For erase only: etag from the preview the user confirmed. Reuse it on uncertain retries.

tools.name: reset
tools.description: Explicitly replace an existing companion with a new random companion. Requires user confirmation RESET NOTEBUDDY and a fresh inspect ETag. UI must clean chat and all portraits before finish. Resume a pending reset; never automatically begin a new reset on conflicts. A removed game may explicitly start a new companion through reset; deleted records are never recovered.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: inspect previews the save; begin stages one new pet; finish follows verified UI chat/file cleanup.

parameters.name: confirmation
parameters.description: For begin only: exact user-confirmed phrase RESET NOTEBUDDY.

parameters.name: expected_etag
parameters.description: For begin only: ETag from the preview the user confirmed; never refresh it automatically.

parameters.name: reset_id
parameters.description: Stable UUID for this confirmed reset. Reuse on begin and finish retries.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: For begin only: new companion name, 1–24 characters.
